explanation.en: Pools offer “lessons only for adults”, often in the evening. Answer: adults.
explanation.kk: Бассейндер көбіне кешке «lessons only for adults» ұсынады. Жауап adults.
explanation.ru: Бассейны предлагают «lessons only for adults», часто вечером. Ответ adults.

RT-GT-SUM-M-Q1.quote: Swimming pools increasingly offer lessons only for adults

explanation.en: “take place in shallow water” → shallow water. Two words fit the limit.
explanation.kk: «take place in shallow water» → shallow water. Екі сөз — шектен аспайды.
explanation.ru: «take place in shallow water» → shallow water. Два слова — в пределах лимита.

RT-GT-SUM-M-Q2.quote: The first lessons usually take place in shallow water

explanation.en: The biggest step is learning to “put the face in the water and breathe out slowly”. “Hardest” paraphrases “biggest” → slowly.
explanation.kk: Ең үлкен қадам — «put the face in the water and breathe out slowly» үйрену. «Hardest» — «biggest» дегеннің басқаша айтылымы, жауап slowly.
explanation.ru: Самый большой шаг — научиться «put the face in the water and breathe out slowly». «Hardest» пересказывает «biggest», ответ slowly.

RT-GT-SUM-M-Q3.quote: learning to put the face in the water and breathe out slowly is the biggest step

explanation.en: Learners kick “while holding a float” and add arm movements later. Answer: float.
explanation.kk: Алдымен аяқпен жұмыс істейді, «while holding a float», қолды кейін қосады. Жауап float.
explanation.ru: Сначала работают ногами, «while holding a float», а руки добавляют позже. Ответ float.

RT-GT-SUM-M-Q4.quote: they are taught to kick with their legs while holding a float

explanation.en: “after about ten lessons” → ten lessons (or 10 lessons). “Five seconds” in paragraph 4 is an example goal.
explanation.kk: «after about ten lessons» → ten lessons (немесе 10 lessons). 4-абзацтағы «five seconds» — мақсаттың мысалы.
explanation.ru: «after about ten lessons» → ten lessons (или 10 lessons). «Five seconds» из абзаца 4 — пример цели.

RT-GT-SUM-M-Q5.quote: most adults can swim a width of the pool after about ten lessons

explanation.en: “Fear is the most common obstacle” → fear, letter F. “Problem” = “obstacle”.
explanation.kk: «Fear is the most common obstacle» → fear, яғни F әрпі. «Problem» = «obstacle».
explanation.ru: «Fear is the most common obstacle» → fear, буква F. «Problem» = «obstacle».

RT-GT-SUM-M-Q6.quote: Fear is the most common obstacle.

explanation.en: “recommend setting small goals” → goals, letter C.
explanation.kk: «recommend setting small goals» — шағын мақсат қою → goals, яғни C әрпі.
explanation.ru: «recommend setting small goals» → goals, буква C.

explanation.en: “during quiet times at the pool” → quiet, letter G. B (busy) is the opposite.
explanation.kk: «during quiet times at the pool» → quiet, яғни G әрпі. B (busy) — керісінше.
explanation.ru: «during quiet times at the pool» → quiet, буква G. B (busy) — противоположность.

RT-GT-SUM-M-Q8.quote: practising between lessons during quiet times at the pool

explanation.en: “want to improve their technique” → technique, letter E. H (strokes) appears in paragraph 2 about first lessons.
explanation.kk: «want to improve their technique» → technique, яғни E әрпі. H (strokes) 2-абзацта алғашқы сабақ туралы аталған.
explanation.ru: «want to improve their technique» → technique, буква E. H (strokes) упомянуты во 2-м абзаце про первые уроки.

explanation.ru: «include video recordings, so that swimmers can see how they move» → video, буква A.
